scriptData.label: Add granted Talents, Traits and items

description.label: Description
description.value:
Major Physical Mutation

Your body outgrows the limits of your species to monstrous proportions. Increase your @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.8slW8CJ2oVTxeQ6q]{Size} by one. If you're Small, you become Average. If you're Average you become Large, and so on. You gain the respective Size Trait and the modifiers defined below. Adjust your Wounds according to your new size. You cannot gain this mutation if you have @UUID[Compendium.artantares-mutations.items.Item.3E6e9h4PEQLQfPtJ]{Pitiful Stature} already.

  • Small to Average : +1 Movement, +10 S, +10 T

  • Average to Large : +2 Movement, +15 S, +15 T, -5 Agi

  • Large to Enormous : +10 S, +5 T, -10 Agi +1 Armour, @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.UmxGZRV0Lw3TZ0Kx]{Stride} Creature Trait

  • Enormous to Monstrous : +2 Movement, +20 S, +10 T, -10 Agi, +1 Armour
